newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Surya rises on talk of new investor.
newsitem.headline: Surya rises on talk of new investor.

text.p: Indonesian property developer PT Surya Semesta Internusa rose 6.82 percent on Monday on intense market talk of a possible bid for a stake in the company and speculation of higher profits, brokers said.

At 0730 GMT, Surya Semesta rose 75 rupiah to 1,175 rupiah. It was the most active stock with about 30 million shares traded. It was also cross-traded at 1,175 rupiah on a volume of 6.2 million shares.
"A rumour has spreading since morning that a tobacco tycoon will be buying a stake in Surya Semesta," one broker with local firm said.
Another broker said active trading in the counter was also linked to speculation that the firm will revise up its profit target for 1997.
"I heard they are going to announce the profit target revision during the shareholders' meeting next week," the broker said.
The company was scheduled to hold its annual shareholders meeting on June 15.
Company officials could not be reached for confirmation.
Surya Semesta was also the most active stock last Friday with about 46.7 million shares traded on expectation of a higher-than-expected net profit in the first quarter, brokers said.
